title: Ampersand: choose the visual world (native macOS)
question: Steer applied: native, modern macOS, Apple HIG. The roll assigned Spotlight-lineage Command Bar. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Command Bar
options.lineage: macOS 26 Spotlight with quick actions; Liquid Glass popover, SF Pro, SF Symbols
options.thesis: Ampersand is driven like Spotlight: the popover opens with focus in a filter field, arrows select, Return starts or stops, every action has a key.
options.viewport: Popover: filter field on top; rows of commands (glyph, name, port, live CPU/mem, uptime); the selected row expands to show its last log lines and action keys (↩ start/stop, ⌘R restart, ⌘L full log).
options.risk: Keyboard-first can hide actions from mouse use; every key action needs a visible hover control too.

raised.raise: A fixed status-glyph vocabulary: filled = running, dashed = restarting, octagon = crashed, hollow = stopped. Shape, not just colour.
Nothing silently resets: an exited command keeps its stamp (exit 1 · 14:02) until you act on it.
One text size in the popover; rank comes from weight and secondary label colour, never size jumps.
Live numbers use tabular figures and update in place with no layout shift.
Accent colour appears only where something can be pressed; status colours live only in the glyph.

regions.label: last log lines  ·  ↩ stop  ⌘R restart  ⌘L log

options.label: Console Tail
options.lineage: Console.app and Xcode's run log; native list rows
options.thesis: Each row's subtitle is the command's newest log line, so the output itself is the status.
options.viewport: Popover rows: glyph, name, port; under it the last stdout line in SF Mono, turning red with the final error line on a crash.
options.risk: Familiar from Xcode and many dev utilities; noisy servers can make rows flicker.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: One axis slider remaps the whole grid live.
options.viewport: A giant & with live readouts below.
options.case: Loses both axes against a native brief.
options.kept: Live readouts that update in place.

options.label: Warm Consumer Surface
options.thesis: Soft cards; one bright colour only where you can act.
options.viewport: Card per command with a bottom bar.
options.case: Loses both axes: devs on a Mac don't identify with it.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.thesis: One type size; rank by weight, case and rule.
options.kept: Single type size, rank by weight.

options.label: Centre Rail Setting
options.thesis: States as printed marks with fixed meanings.
options.viewport: Two columns around a key rail.
options.kept: A fixed mark-shape vocabulary for state.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.risk: Costume risk in a native app.
options.kept: Exit stamps persist until acted on.

canonCard.label: Native macOS utility
canonCard.thesis: Control Center-style rows with a toggle per command, executed with full HIG craft.
canonCard.viewport: Popover with grouped rows: status dot, name, port, on/off switch; window is sidebar + log detail.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other menu bar utilities by design.
